FIELDS.NAME: Paper Trail Stationery Co.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Paper Trail Stationery Co., we specialize in the retail of a wide range of stationery and paper products, catering to both individual customers and businesses. Our operations are centered in a single physical location, where we provide a diverse selection of items including notebooks, writing instruments, office supplies, and craft materials. We prioritize quality by sourcing products from established suppliers who adhere to documented safety and labeling regulations. Our inventory management system enables us to maintain optimal stock levels, ensuring that we can meet seasonal demands, particularly during back-to-school and holiday periods. Additionally, we have established an online sales platform that supports secure transactions, expanding our market reach while maintaining strict compliance with cybersecurity measures. Customer service is enhanced through regular training of our staff, fostering product knowledge and improving customer satisfaction. Overall, we strive to create a responsible retail environment that emphasizes quality, compliance, and community engagement.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Description: 01/15/2023, theft of inventory due to a break-in, $1,200.00, paid out and case closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Class B, Grade 2, Secure Vault
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Local security patrol service during operating hours.
